data.name: Gloriane
data.gender_notes: Gloriane is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gloria', meaning 'glory', 'renown', or 'praise'. In Christian tradition, this name represents the radiant light of God or the radiance of the Holy Spirit. It is also associated with the virtue of humility, as those who truly shine with God's glory recognize their dependence on His grace. The name Gloriane carries the meaning “Glorying, shining with radiance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gloriane usually hope their child will grow to embody glorying, shining with radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Γλωριανή
in_greek.long_meaning: Δόξα του Θεού, το όνομα Γλωριανή προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'δόξα' και 'Θεός', που σημαίνει την δόξα και την αίγλη του Θεού. Το όνομα αντανακλά την έννοια της θειακής δόξας και της πνευματικής ακτινοβολίας που συνδέεται με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Gloriana
